peg_reference.notes: WrappedCBDC Terms define cNGN as a 1:1 tokenized representation of the Nigerian Naira.

yield_or_rebase_profile.notes: Treasury/yield services may be offered separately to eligible users; the cNGN token itself is not described as intrinsically yield-bearing.

classification_notes: Privately issued NGN stablecoin under Nigerian SEC oversight, minted against Naira deposits and redeemable to Naira by verified users. 'other' preserves the issuer's broader Naira-denominated reserve-asset wording without inventing a current allocation.
